# JR Vintage Media

> A one-person VHS and camcorder tape-to-digital conversion service in Australia, run by Jack Racovalis. Converts VHS, VHS-C, Hi8, Video8, Digital8, and MiniDV tapes to digital files by hand, with free tape cleaning and repair included.

Key facts:
- Pricing: $35 per tape (1-5 tapes), $32 per tape (6-10 tapes), $30 per tape (11+ tapes), standard play up to 2 hours. Surcharges apply for recordings longer than 2 hours.
- Delivery options: USB stick (from $18), external hard drive (from $45), private YouTube link, or Google Drive
- Files delivered as MP4, playable on Mac, Windows, phones, and smart TVs
- Free tape cleaning and repair included in every order
- Typical turnaround: 1-2 weeks depending on order size
- Service area: Australia-wide via mail-in, plus local drop-off
- Payment taken only once the order is complete
- Contact: jackrac@jrvintagemedia.com, +61 481 198 213
